svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 228 mm of 3 mm stainless rod.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut an M3 thread 8 mm long on one end with a die.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round the other end slightly with a file: a blunt tip, not a point.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: screws into the heat-set insert in the skirt boss, 26 mm off

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the head axis, and rises through the foam windscreen.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Unscrew it before you lift the windscreen off.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it stands upright and its top is 160 mm above the port.
